options.title: Every AMC moviegoer spends {fact1} on snacks. How much does AMC keep? 🍿
options.first_line: Every AMC moviegoer spends {fact1} on snacks. So how much of that does AMC keep?
options.first_frame: Rohan at an AMC snack counter hands over his card for a giant tub of popcorn, the price board above him showing the snack figure, the AMC sign glowing red.

options.title: Why is popcorn at AMC so expensive? 🍿
options.first_line: Why is popcorn at AMC, the world's biggest cinema chain, so expensive?
options.first_frame: A giant popcorn tub with the AMC logo overflows on the counter while Rohan stares wide-eyed at the price board behind it.

options.title: AMC charges {fact2} a ticket. Why does it care more about your popcorn? 🍿
options.first_line: AMC charges {fact2} for a movie ticket. So why does it care more about your popcorn?
options.first_frame: A cinema box office with an AMC sign: a ticket with its price slides out of the window, and behind it a popcorn machine glows brighter than the screen.

why: It names AMC and something every viewer buys, then poses a real puzzle (why would a cinema care more about popcorn than tickets?) that only the story answers, and the ticket price plus glowing popcorn machine reads without sound.
